# Venngage

> > Venngage is an AI-powered visual design platform offering 10,000+ templates for creating infographics, presentations, and marketing materials without design experience.

Venngage provides a comprehensive suite of drag-and-drop design tools with AI generators, accessibility features (WCAG compliance), and brand customization capabilities. The platform supports multiple export formats (PDF, PNG, PowerPoint) and enables team collaboration for professional content creation across various industries.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered design
- Drag-and-drop editor
- Template library
- Data visualization
- Brand customization
- Accessibility features (WCAG)
- Export formats (PDF, PNG, PPT)
- Interactive PDF
- No design experience required
- Free design tools
- Graphic design
- My Brand Kit
- Team collaboration
- AI Infographic generator
- Chart templates

## Core Platform & Features

- [Venngage | Professional Infographic Software | 10,000+ Templates](https://venngage.com): Homepage showcasing Venngage's AI-powered infographic design platform with 10,000+ templates
- [Venngage features - Venngage](https://venngage.com/features): Overview of Venngage's key features including AI generators for infographics, flyers, posters, proposals
- [Accessible PDF Maker](https://venngage.com/features/accessible): Venngage's accessible PDF maker with WCAG compliance and AI-powered accessibility features

## Data Visualization & Charts

- [Free Infographic Maker - Make Infographics within Seconds](https://venngage.com/features/infographic-maker): Core infographic maker tool with drag-and-drop editor and 100s of customizable templates
- [Free Online Graph Maker | Create stunning charts in minutes](https://venngage.com/features/graph-maker): Graph maker for data visualization with customizable charts and business presentation templates
- [Online Pie Chart Maker - Create Your Own Pie Charts - Venngage](https://venngage.com/features/pie-chart-maker): Pie chart maker for data visualization in business reports with donut chart options
- [Free Timeline Maker – Create Chronologies Easily](https://venngage.com/features/timeline-infographics): Timeline maker with customizable templates for project milestones and business chronologies

## Marketing & Business Materials

- [Free Poster Maker - Increase Visibility with Stunning Posters](https://venngage.com/features/poster-maker): Free poster maker with AI generator and drag-and-drop editor for business marketing
- [Free Flyer Maker Online | Design Flyers Without Watermark](https://venngage.com/features/flyer-maker): Flyer maker tool for event promotion and marketing materials without watermarks
- [Free Brochure Maker | Create a Brochure Online](https://venngage.com/features/brochure-maker): Free brochure maker with accessible templates and no design experience required
- [Online Newsletter Creator and Free Easy-to-Edit Templates - Venngage](https://venngage.com/features/newsletter-design): Newsletter creator with HTML export and brand customization for email marketing
- [Create a Case Study | Free Case Study Creator](https://venngage.com/features/create-a-case-study): Case study creator with templates for marketing and data visualization collaboration

## Content & Knowledge Materials
